relations: From the raised-arm wide stance, hands curl into fists and descend toward the waist while legs narrow and torso straightens.
As the stance closes, one leg lifts with bent knee while an arm extends outward with open palm before returning.
Hands settle near hips; one arm flicks outward then rises with flat hand near face, the other resting on hip.
The wall mirror reproduces each arm and leg motion in sync against the fixed barre and string lights.
caption: The video captures a dancer filmed from behind in a mirrored studio, performing choreographed arm and leg movements. She wears a black cutout crop top, wide-leg black pants, and a pink face mask visible in the wall-length mirror. In the opening frames both arms are raised beside her head, fingers forming a two-finger gesture over a wide stance. The hands then curl into fists and draw down toward the waist as the stance narrows and the body straightens. One leg lifts with a bent knee while an arm extends outward with an open palm before returning. Hands settle near the hips as one arm flicks outward, then that arm rises with a flat hand near the face while the other rests on the hip. Throughout, the mirror reflection reproduces every movement in sync against the fixed barre and string lights.
